text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio's debut race has finally 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, is it time yet!? Time for my 
race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I wonder. My heart is beating pretty 
fast, though.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I kinda feel like it's just 'cause 
I really wanna run fast... I don't really 
get it!”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it doesn't bother me, so don't 
you worry, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep, off I go! It's the dawn of the Teio 
legend~!!
